sources.setting: Adult primary human keratinocytes in culture, three donors, 20-minute imaging, 11-16 days.
sources.extraction: EXP and DIF sheets; five-column colony blocks, generation, T1, T2, recorded delta-T(hrs), division type. Generation 1 is excluded from fits. Preserve every generation-bearing row with source duration cell. Positive recorded durations count as completed divisions only when the mother has two daughter fate labels drawn from P/D/U. Classified subset restricts fate to PP/PD/DP/DD, reproducing published N=1017 EXP and 174 DIF. No donor-to-colony mapping inferred.

sources.storage_reason: Full publisher workbook retained in the local Git research cache; not redistributed in the public checkout. Tracked outputs contain the minimal numerical extraction and derived analysis, with source addresses and attribution.
sources.setting: Human neonatal foreskin and adult keratinocyte cultures, homeostatic/confluence/scratch conditions are separate sheets.
sources.extraction: Find actual Clone headers in row 1 rather than infer a regular stride; cached numeric delta-T(hrs) at block+5, generation at block start. Numeric local generation >1 and a positive duration with two P/D/U daughter fate labels are eligible. Keep Outer/D generation labels and missing durations in CSV. NFSK expanding Fig2a excluded from fits because reset subclone generations and biological cell identity are unresolved; naive counts do not reproduce published 2127 neonatal cycles. Keep sheet identity and cell address; do not pool contexts or deduplicate identical times without cell identity.
